'''Longland grass''' is an [[above ground|aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can be [[milling|milled]] into [[Flour|Longland flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|Longland beer]]. It is equal in value to underground crops and is much like an aboveground version of [[cave wheat]]. It is notable for being the only crop featuring capitalization in its name.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] Longland grass for its ''sweeping stalks''.
